snapshot.text: Flughafen Wien, the Vienna airport group, grew revenue by {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}} in FY2024, and the full repayment of interest-bearing financial liabilities leaves it with net cash of {{net_cash@FY2024}}.
Net leverage fell by {{net_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{net_leverage@FY2024}}, a net cash position, while the EBITDA margin was broadly unchanged at {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}.
The point to watch is cash generation: free cash flow declined by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}} as capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}.

credit_metrics.text: EBITDA increased by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}} on revenue up {{revenue.change@FY2024}}, and operating profit rose by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}}.
Total debt was stable at {{total_debt@FY2024}}, so gross leverage held at {{gross_leverage@FY2024}} and net cash rose by {{net_cash.change@FY2024}} to {{net_cash@FY2024}}.

FFO increased by {{ffo.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo@FY2024}}, but free cash flow fell by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}} as capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}.

operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}}, but traffic growth of {{traffic_growth@FY2024}} was below the peer median of {{traffic_growth.peer_median@FY2024}} and down by {{traffic_growth.change@FY2024}} on the prior year.

Aeronautical revenue per passenger increased by {{aero_revenue_per_passenger.change@FY2024}} to {{aero_revenue_per_passenger@FY2024}}, with airport charges temporarily adjusted by average inflation under the amended airport charges act.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue up by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.
Cash liquidity of {{cash_liquidity@FY2024}} covers total debt of {{total_debt@FY2024}} many times over, and the group repaid its interest-bearing financial liabilities in full during the year.
A financing commitment was given for the City Air Terminal joint venture's new train sets, part of which was drawn as a loan in the year.

peer_positioning.text: Flughafen Wien has the lowest net leverage of the airport group ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}), against a peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2024}}, and the lowest gross leverage ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}).
Cash liquidity to revenue is the strongest of the group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2024}}), well above the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.
The EBITDA margin sits in the middle of the group, and capex intensity is in line with the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2024}}.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow fell by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}} as capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, in line with the peer median.

Traffic: growth of {{traffic_growth@FY2024}} is below the peer median of {{traffic_growth.peer_median@FY2024}} and the weakest of the group ({{traffic_growth.peer_rank@FY2024}}), which limits the operating leverage behind the earnings base.
Regulation: airport charges are temporarily adjusted by average inflation, a rule that ends at the end of 2026, so revenue per passenger depends on the tariff formula that follows.
Third runway: complaints were filed against the extension of the construction completion deadline and the single-party procedure, without suspensive effect.
